summary: Full E2E test of Deliciosas Cucas pay-on-delivery flow. Backend: 15/15 pytest pass (products+flavors CRUD, orders with flavor -> payment_status 'A pagar na entrega', status->payment mapping Pago/Aguardando Pagamento, settings GET/PUT with digit normalization, coupon validate/apply/decrement/exhaustion, Stripe endpoints 404, admin login). Frontend: flavor select + error toast w/o flavor, qty stepper, separate cart lines per flavor ('Sabor: X'), cart inc/dec/remove, 3-step checkout, coupon (10% applied correctly), 4 payment options, no Stripe/payment API calls, confirmation shows '<method> (na entrega)', pay-on-delivery notice, wa.me/5541989023769 link with code/items+flavor/discount/total/address/notes; cart cleared on close. Admin: login (wrong pw rejected), orders show flavor, 6 statuses incl. new ones, 'Entregue - Aguardando Pagamento' calls window.open wa.me/55<customer phone> with charge msg incl. Pix key from settings, button text switches to 'Enviar cobrança no WhatsApp', 'Entregue e Pago' does not open WhatsApp and persists payment_status Pago; coupon creation & usage count; product form categories correct and flavors comma-split/trimmed/empty-filtered saved as list. All requested features work.

minor.issue: Item prices/names are trusted from the client; totals are computed from client-sent price (price tampering possible). Flavor not validated against product flavors. Should look up product by product_id.
No server-side auth; admin password is only checked client-side. GET /api/orders exposes customer PII publicly; anyone can change settings (e.g. store WhatsApp / Pix key).
Accepts empty store_whatsapp -> storefront link becomes https://wa.me/55?text=...
order_code ENC-<4 random digits> without uniqueness check; coupon used_count increment not atomic (race can exceed max_uses).

ui_bugs.issue: Edit title still says 'Editar Lanche' (old app wording) instead of 'Editar Produto'

issues: Calendar renders in English ('October 2026', Su/Mo/Tu) in a Portuguese app - pass ptBR locale from date-fns to Calendar
'Válido até' uses native <input type=date> instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover
Products created without image_url show broken image alt text - add placeholder fallback
Torta de Limão image shows a berry/fruit tart, not a lemon meringue pie

critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx is 631 lines - consider splitting into OrdersTab/MenuTab/CouponsTab/SettingsTab components
waUrl() treats any number starting with '55' as already having country code - a customer phone with DDD 55 (RS) typed without +55 (e.g. 55 99999-8888) would be sent to the wrong number
changeStatus opens WhatsApp before PATCH succeeds; if PATCH fails the charge message is still opened
CheckoutDialog delivery_date uses date.toISOString() - fine for UTC-3 but shifts a day in UTC+ timezones; prefer date-fns format(date,'yyyy-MM-dd')
No delete endpoint for orders; test orders (TEST_Cliente, TEST Maria) remain in DB
seed_data_creation: Created test orders (customer TEST_Cliente / TEST Maria, cannot be deleted - no endpoint). Test products/coupons deleted. Settings restored to store_whatsapp=5541989023769, pix_key=''.
